Macrons

Consonantal i

Clothes & getting dressed

dress noun

classical

Traupman 116
M-O s.v. dress

vestis muliebris

Skirt: Traupman 118 gives castula and indūcula, both ancient women’s under-garments, and Morgan–Owens gives Plautus’s calthula; none means a modern skirt, so we leave the word open.

Other words

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Traupman 116; M-O s.v. dress

  • vestis tālāris — long dress

    also used · classical

See also T-shirt.
